extendedData.name: OracleText
extendedData.value:
Secret Lair will group existing cards into small collectible sets with strange themes and wild new art styles. Drops will contain between three and seven predetermined cards and tokens in a customized collector box.

You will receive all 7 of the Secret Lair Drop Series:

• 1x Bitterblossom Dreams
• 1x Eldraine Wonderland
• 1x Restless in Peace
• 1x Seeing Visions
• 1x “explosion sounds”
• 1x Kaleidoscope Killers
• 1x OMG KITTIES!
The first wave of this Secret Lair Drop Series Sealed Product (shipped Dec. 2019) includes 1 of 15 possible Stained Glass Planeswalkers from WAR per Drop Series item. This card is randomized per sealed Drop Series item.
